nuggets.text: Jimmy Rogers won an FCS national title and coach of the year in his debut season as South Dakota State's head coach.
Jimmy Rogers played linebacker at South Dakota State and made 312 tackles in 46 games.
Jaylen Raynor once threw a program-record six touchdown passes against UMass as an Arkansas State freshman.
Isaac Terrell became the first Cyclone since 2006 with multiple sacks in his debut.
The Cyclones have won the last two Cy-Hawk games, 20-19 in Iowa City and 16-13 in Ames.
Kyle Konrardy hit a 54-yard field goal in the Cyclones' 16-13 Cy-Hawk win last year.
The Cyclones' mascot is a cardinal named Cy because a cyclone was too hard to turn into a costume.
The Cy-Hawk series went on pause after 1934 and did not resume for more than four decades, until 1977.
Jaylen Raynor threw two touchdowns and ran for two more in the Cyclones' 38-10 opening win.
Jack Trice Stadium is the only FBS stadium named for an African American, Iowa State's first Black athlete.
